name: radix-key-binder-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; root=$PWD; out=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; export PATH="$root/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; export LEAN_PATH="$root/radix-retained/.lake/build/lib/lean"; lean -o "$out/RadixKeySyntax.olean" research/bapa/RadixKeySyntax.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/check.log"; cp research/bapa/RadixKeySyntax.lean "$out/"
